title: Prove a physical-norm invariant rectangle after finite actuation
statement: For mean-zero physical u let y=||u||2^2,z=||grad u||2^2,r=||Delta u||2^2; z>=y,r>=z,z^2<=yr. Agmon constant16 gives |<B(u,u),Delta u>|<=64 z^(3/4)r^(3/4). With C_H=2^80, zprime+nu r<=C_H nu^-3 z^3+4nu^-1 eta^2 and yprime+nu z<=nu^-1 eta^2. Set C=2^50,Y=nu^4/(C^2 M^2),Z=16M^2,eta_g=nu^3/(8CM). Within y<=Y,z<=Z, z^3<=yzr and16C_H/C^2<1/2 absorb the cubic term, giving zprime+nu r/2<=4nu^-1 eta_g^2. At each upper boundary the corresponding derivative is strictly negative (eta_g^2=nu^2 Y/64), so the rectangle is forward invariant. This controls actual norms after the carrier has ended, for arbitrary admitted future measurable L2 disturbances; it is not a transformed metric or an H1-smallness assertion.
